title: Termwise pushforward equivalence for coherent thickening systems
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I$ an ideal, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-base-change], $j_n:X_n\to X$, and $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Assume $X$ is Noetherian, $j_n$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with kernel $J^{n+1}$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ satisfy both pullback projection identities, including the quotient factor map on the second projection. Specify adjunctions $a_i:i_n^*\dashv i_{n,*}$ and $a_j:j_n^*\dashv j_{n,*}$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. There is an equivalence functor $\Phi:\mathrm{Sys}(X_n,i_n)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,J)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-thickening-system, def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] with natural evaluation isomorphisms $\beta_n:(\Phi M)_n\cong j_{n,*}M_n$. Under $\beta$ its adjacent transition is $j_{n+1,*}$ of the $a_i$-adjoint of $M$\textquotesingle s pullback comparison, followed by the canonical pushforward-composition comparison and the comparison induced by $i_nj_{n+1}=j_n$. No completion functor, morphism dictionary, or support assertion is included.

source.place: Remark 088F (remark-reformulate-existence-theorem), Lemma 087T (lemma-i-star-equivalence); the termwise dictionary before algebraization

proof.text: 1. Instantiate the explicit pushed inverse-system functor P on T_n=X_n, j_n=pullback.fst, hi and ai. Its object data, all transitions, maps, functor laws and evaluation comparisons are constructed explicitly; its adjacent formula is proved. No choices from adic object existence enter these definitions.

2. Use the adic object assertion with J=I O_X and hgeom, and ObjectProperty.lift to restrict P to Φ:Sys(T,i)→Coh(X,J). This restriction only needs a proof of the property of the explicitly defined object.

3. The explicit P is full and faithful because hgeom supplies closed j_n. The lift inherits Full and Faithful. For any H, apply the object lifting theorem and lift the resulting inverse-system isomorphism with ObjectProperty.isoMk. Hence Φ is essentially surjective. Mathlib Functor.IsEquivalence combines these three properties.

4. Use the definitional evaluation comparisons β. Their components are identity maps, so the β transition equation reduces by comp_id and id_comp to thickeningSystemPushforward_transition. The second projection identity hi₂ and adjunctions aj remain in the original signature but are unnecessary; hgeom and hi already give the closed tower data.

theorem thickeningSystems_pushforward_equivalence {A : Type v} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (I : Ideal A)
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
        pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ,
      i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) =
          pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (hi₂ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      i n ≫ pullback.snd f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) =
      pullback.snd f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (ai : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i n))
    (aj : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ⊣
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    [hX : IsNoetherian X]
    (hgeom : (∀ n : ℕ, IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ∧
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).ker =
            (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
            A)).inv.hom)).comap f ^ (n + 1))) :
    ∃ (Φ : CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i ⥤
          @CoherentFormalModule X hX ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
              (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f))
        (β : ∀ n : ℕ,
          Φ ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsCoherentFormalModule ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map
              (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)) ⋙
            (CategoryTheory.evaluation ℕᵒᵖ X.Modules).obj (op n) ≅
          CoherentThickeningSystem.evaluation (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i n ⋙
            Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))),
        Φ.IsEquivalence ∧
        (∀ (M : CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i) (n : ℕ),
          (((Φ.obj M).obj).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ≫ (β n).hom.app M =
          (β (n + 1)).hom.app M ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).map
              ((ai n).homEquiv _ _ (M.comparison n).hom) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (i n) (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).hom.app
              (M.term n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (hi n)).hom.app (M.term n))
